stage.name: Rest Avenue
stage.description:
A renowned musician is holding a charity concert, but intel indicates that troublemakers have infiltrated the audience, disguised as the Witch King's Remains. Operators are to act promptly to ensure that the concert is held smoothly.
<Condition> DP will not regenerate naturally.
<Waste Energy Interference> Natural SP recovery rate reduced.
<Realigned Flux> Restores natural SP recovery rate of allied Operators within.

street_layabout.name: 'Street Layabout'
street_layabout.flavourText: Armed militants disguised as Infected, they are well-acquainted with the local situation. They look no different from ordinary Infected and easily blend into the crowd.
abilities: When attacking targets outside of Realigned Flux, deals a certain percentage of Arts damage

street_drunk.name: 'Street Drunk'
street_drunk.flavourText: Armed militants disguised as Infected, they are overly acquainted with the local situation, to the point that they have become alcoholics hanging around the street pubs, their mission long forgotten.
abilities: When attacking targets outside of Realigned Flux, deals a certain percentage of Arts damage

blackwater_originium_slug_enemy_1246_asl.name: Blackwater Originium Slug
blackwater_originium_slug_enemy_1246_asl.flavourText: A wild infected creature that normally lives in the nomadic city's sewers, it has surfaced after being provoked. It emits an unpleasant odor, but what's more vexing is that no one knows where they will pop up from next.
abilities: Can appear in the battlefield

street_performer.name: 'Street Performer'
street_performer.flavourText: Armed militants disguised as Infected, they know the local situation by heart. Their weapon of choice is the triangle simply because it is easy to carry around, and definitely not because the triangle has no grade certification and is easy to play.
abilities: When attacking targets outside of Realigned Flux, deals an additional hit

spire_caster.name: Spire Caster
spire_caster.flavourText: One of the backbones of the Leithanian army. Able to cause large area damage under relatively stable conditions. Absent support equipment and personnel, they are vulnerable to interference from external energy.
abilities: Attacks 2 enemies simultaneously
When attacking targets outside of Realigned Flux, deals Splash damage

street_musician.name: 'Street Musician'
street_musician.flavourText: Armed militants disguised as Infected, they are overly acquainted with the local situation. Aware that they may be exposed by their unfamiliarity with other instruments, they choose to use the triangle.
abilities: When attacking targets outside of Realigned Flux, deals an additional hit

blackwater_originium_slug_enemy_1246_asl.name: Blackwater Originium Slug α
blackwater_originium_slug_enemy_1246_asl.flavourText: A wild infected creature that is more dangerous than a normal Blackwater Originium Slug. It normally lives in the nomadic city's sewers, but has surfaced after being provoked. Both its striking odor and its elusiveness often catch people off-guard.
abilities: Can appear in the battlefield

winterwisp_hound.name: Winterwisp Hound
winterwisp_hound.flavourText: A hunting hound trained and utilized by locals since ancient times. For early aboriginals and pioneers, these hounds were considered invaluable partners.

battleworn_spire_caster.name: Battleworn Spire Caster
battleworn_spire_caster.flavourText: A Spire Caster with experience in war. Specializes in causing extreme area damage under relatively stable conditions. While highly confident, they are still vulnerable to interference from external energy.
abilities: Attacks 2 enemies simultaneously
When attacking targets outside of Realigned Flux, deals Splash damage

remnant_saxophonist.name: Remnant Saxophonist
remnant_saxophonist.flavourText: Irritable remnants of the Witch King, they once attempted to bribe their way into a certain orchestra in the capital. After many years of lying low, they have lost much of their sanity and now try to tear their enemies apart using music itself.
abilities: When blowing at full force, fires ranged attacks in all 4 directions, dealing high Physical damage to allies hit. These attacks can be blocked by Realigned Flux

enhanced_mass_produced_colossus.name: Enhanced Mass-Produced Colossus
enhanced_mass_produced_colossus.flavourText: An Originium Arts creation that sacrifices stability for miniaturization. Very well-equipped for breaching, it is often used to break through enemy lines. Its physical strength has been improved but its weakness to interference remains an issue.
abilities: Can only be blocked by units with at least 2 Block
When in Realigned Flux, DEF and RES are greatly reduced

remnant_principal_violinist.name: Remnant Principal Violinist
remnant_principal_violinist.flavourText: Scheming remnants of the Witch King, they were once the principal violinist of a certain orchestra in the capital. It's said that they stole their position from another by forcing the stage setup to be changed.
abilities: Attacks can travel along Realigned Flux, dealing damage to all connected units

mass_produced_colossus.name: Mass-Produced Colossus
mass_produced_colossus.flavourText: An Originium Arts creation that sacrifices stability for miniaturization. Well-equipped for breaching, it is often used to break through enemy lines. Like its creator, it is vulnerable to interference from external energy.
abilities: Can only be blocked by units with at least 2 Block
When in Realigned Flux, DEF and RES are greatly reduced

remnant_elite_field_caster.name: Remnant Elite Field Caster
remnant_elite_field_caster.flavourText: Unrepentant remnants of the Witch King, they were once the sponsor of a certain orchestra in the capital. There are whispers of connections to the Spire, but most of these turned out to be nothing more than far-fetched rumors.
abilities: Prioritizes targets on Realigned Flux, Stunning them and continually dealing Arts damage while cutting off nearby Realigned Flux

remnant_official_saxophonist.name: Remnant Official Saxophonist
remnant_official_saxophonist.flavourText: Hysterical remnants of the Witch King, they once spent large sums of money to join a certain orchestra in the capital, yet were too impatient to arrange a rehearsal of the saxophone concerto with their sponsor.
abilities: When blowing at full force, fires ranged attacks in all 4 directions, dealing high Physical damage to allies hit. These attacks can be blocked by Realigned Flux

remnant_field_caster.name: Remnant Field Caster
remnant_field_caster.flavourText: Stubborn remnants of the Witch King, they were once the composer of a certain orchestra in the capital. During their many years of lying low, they researched vile arts nearly lost to mankind, staining their hands red with blood, yet they have little to show for it.
abilities: Prioritizes targets on Realigned Flux, Stunning them and continually dealing Arts damage while cutting off nearby Realigned Flux

remnant_violinist.name: Remnant Violinist
remnant_violinist.flavourText: Cunning remnants of the Witch King, they were once violinists of a certain orchestra in the capital. Years of lying low have honed their observational prowess, and they will make use of anything to defeat their enemies.
abilities: Attacks can travel along Realigned Flux, dealing damage to all connected units

dame_gertrude.name: Dame Gertrude
dame_gertrude.flavourText: Gertrude Strollo, Lehnsfrau of Vyseheim and a researcher of energy induction and redirection. Suffers from chronic insomnia and often goes without sleep.
abilities: Attacks two targets simultaneously.
Cannot be blocked.
Can create a <Virtual Image> at the current location
